title: My Redeemer Lives
lyrics_original: Whom have I in Heaven but You?
There is none besides You I desire.
For I know that my Redeemer lives!
All control is within His hands.
Lord create a clean heart in me,
And let only what’s from You remain.
If need be, when in trials
For I know that my Redeemer lives!
All control is within His hands.
When trials seem too difficult for me,
Let Your grace be my sufficiency!
For I know that my Redeemer lives!
All control is within His hands.
For I know that my Redeemer lives!
All control is within His hands.

bible_verses.english: For I know that my Redeemer lives! In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
Whom have I in heaven but you? There is no one on earth that I desire besides you. My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my living Redeemer and the ultimate desire of my heart. When my body and spirit grow weary, remind me that You are my strength and my portion forever. I place all my cares into Your capable hands, trusting that You hold full control over my life. Fix my eyes on You today, so I may walk in peace knowing my future is eternally secure in Your love. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When our physical strength fades and life feels uncertain, this song reminds us where our true hope rests. Anchored in the truth that our Redeemer lives, we can surrender our worries to the One who holds all control in His loving hands. He does not just give us strength; He becomes our strength and our eternal portion when our own hearts fail. Today, let this declaration lift your eyes above temporary struggles to behold the living Savior who holds your future secure.
